name: superfile
summary: Open-source terminal file manager written in Go, with multiple panels, image preview, themes and plugins.
description: A terminal file manager for macOS, Linux and Windows built with Go and Bubble Tea: copy, move, delete and rename files, fuzzy search, bulk operations, image preview, split directory panels, remappable hotkeys and 20+ built-in themes, extensible with community plugins. Installs via one-line script, Homebrew, Winget, Scoop, pacman, Nix or Pixi, and runs with the spf command. MIT licensed.
contains: open-source terminal file manager in Go with Bubble Tea; MIT licensed
file operations, fuzzy search, bulk operations and image preview
multiple directory panels with copy and paste across panels
remappable hotkeys and 20+ themes (Catppuccin, Nord, Tokyo Night, Dracula, Gruvbox, Rose Pine)
community plugins (Git status integration, system monitoring, custom commands)
installs: script, Homebrew, Winget, Scoop, pacman, Nix, Pixi
runs on macOS, Linux and Windows with the spf command
